t: What would happen if he got the first one
a: لَوْ كَانَ لاِبْنِ آدَمَ وَادِيَانِ مِنْ مَالٍ لاَبْتَغَى ثَالِثًا، وَلاَ يَمْلأُ جَوْفَ ابْنِ آدَمَ إِلاَّ التُّرَابُ
p: Law kāna li-bni Ādama wādiyāni min mālin la-btaghā thālithā, wa lā yamlaʾu jawfa-bni Ādama illa-t-turāb
m: If the son of Adam had two valleys of wealth he would want a third. Nothing fills the belly of the son of Adam except dust.
